remarks: Spacious detached two-car garage available for lease in Stamford's Glenbrook neighborhood. This oversized garage offers ample room for vehicle storage, equipment, tools, or additional storage needs.  Conveniently located just 0.3 miles from the Glenbrook train station, it provides easy access for commuters or anyone seeking secure off-street parking near transit. Tucked away on a quiet street, this is a rare opportunity to lease a well-located detached garage in one of Stamford's established neighborhoods.
